finalText:
**Migration finished.** 36 call sites in 12 files moved to `db.execute`.

Two things I deliberately left alone:
- `cache.query` is a different thing. All 25 uses stayed.
- `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` is vendored code. Its 2 calls stayed.

`node verify.js` passes: "OK every db.query call site moved to db.execute, and nothing else moved".
